definitions.explanation: Extremely large in degree or extent. Used to describe the scale of support, influence, trust, popularity, or other abstract qualities. Implies something far exceeding the ordinary.

examples.japanese: {絶大|ぜつだい}な{人気|にんき}を{誇|ほこ}る。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{若者|わかもの}から{絶大|ぜつだい}な{支持|しじ}を{得|え}ている。
examples.english: She enjoys tremendous support from young people.

examples.japanese: そのブランドは{品質|ひんしつ}の{高|たか}さから{消費者|しょうひしゃ}の{絶大|ぜつだい}な{信頼|しんらい}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: That brand has earned tremendous trust from consumers due to its high quality.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the pattern {絶大|ぜつだい}な + noun. Commonly collocates with abstract nouns like {人気|にんき} (popularity), {信頼|しんらい} (trust), {支持|しじ} (support), and {影響力|えいきょうりょく} (influence). Rarely used as a predicate ({絶大|ぜつだい}だ is uncommon).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶大|ぜつだい}な{人気|にんき}: immense popularity
- {絶大|ぜつだい}な{信頼|しんらい}: tremendous trust
- {絶大|ぜつだい}な{支持|しじ}: overwhelming support
- {絶大|ぜつだい}な{影響力|えいきょうりょく}: tremendous influence
